        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"pem\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\ndata\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----", config);
